articles.description:
There is no honest public number for what a design engineer earns in Europe.
Search for one and you will find plenty of figures. PayScale puts the German average at €54,006. SalaryExpert says €79,419 for the Netherlands. A UK survey published this year lands on a £49,489 median, with 88% of its respondents mechanically biased.
Those numbers are real. They are also measuring a different job. Public salary aggregators are reporting on mechanical, hardware and electrical design engineers, because that is what the phrase meant for 40 years before software borrowed it.
This is about the other one: the person who designs a product interface and then ships it to production themselves. The role Linear, Vercel, Stripe and Figma hire for. Two jobs, one name, and no reliable number for the second.
So…
articles.title: Your job title is worth €45,000. We surveyed 106 design engineers to find out.

articles.description:
Context that survives
Answer it without opening a chat window. What does your assistant know this morning that it learned yesterday?
For most setups the honest answer is nothing, and nothing has a price. But that is the easy version of the problem. The one that actually cost me an afternoon is worse: it knew, and it did not tell me. The fact was stored, it was displayed, and I made the mistake anyway. More on that below, because it is the part everybody gets wrong on the first try — and the part nobody warns you about.
Take one week and count the first messages of your sessions. Not all messages, just the opening one of each.

The One-Line Summary: Two extra lines inside the objective — report the score as the model grows, then ask whether to stop — let Optuna abandon 12 of 20 trials before they finished, cutting wall clock from 13.0s to 9.4s at a cost of 0.0005 log loss; the saving is smaller than the kill rate because a pruned trial still runs its warm-up, which is the detail nobody mentions.
Every grid search has the same defect: it runs every candidate to completion, including the ones that were obviously hopeless after 20% of the work. A human watching a training curve would have killed them. Pruning is that human, automated.

Proxy rotation has become essential for businesses and developers who rely on web scraping, market research, or API testing at scale. However, improper proxy rotation can result in blocked requests, IP bans, and failed operations. This guide explores proven strategies to keep your infrastructure resilient while avoiding detection and restrictions.
Proxy rotation is the practice of cycling through multiple IP addresses to distribute traffic load and avoid detection. Websites implement anti-scraping measures that identify and block IPs making unusual request patterns—high volume, rapid requests, or repeated access to sensitive endpoints.
Without rotation, your single IP becomes a bottleneck: it gets rate-limited, blacklisted, or banned entirely. With proper rotation, you distribute requests …
